general_information.Description: This course explores the central concepts of organisational procurement, global sourcing and interfaces of these to the other areas of an organisation. This course provides opportunities to examine issues such as organisational procurement process, global sourcing process, supplier selection process, supplier management and other strategic issues. Teaching method: project-based learning. Students are required to use AI tools to conduct a supply market analysis for a selected industry. The task begins with a macro-level PESTLE analysis, followed by refining prompts to perform a Porter’s Five Forces analysis and identify specific sourcing risks. Throughout the process, students must optimize their use of AI by moving from general to detailed prompts in order to generate deeper insights. They are also expected to observe how different prompt structures influence the quality of strategic analysis, and to validate AI-generated results by cross-checking them against credible articles and industry reports.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination - Actively participate in class activities - Fulfil tasks given by intructor after class - Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose - Read the textbook in advance - Access the course website (www.flm.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: demonstrate basic understanding of procurement of an enterprise
demonstrate understanding of stakeholder management in the given context of an enterprise
demonstrate the ability to select and evaluate supplier
practice the ability to develop a supplier evaluation system for an enterprise
discuss various types of contracts that can be used in procurement
demonstrate understanding of risk in procurement and the ability to mitigate it
discuss some ethical considerations in procurement
apply tools to evaluate a Supply Market from Macro, Industry, and Supplier Level
practice the ability to conduct negotiation in procurement
demonstrate proficiency in applying AI tools to develop solutions to professional issues
